title: Aliexpress.com dispute in progress
description: Dear seller Rocketek, the following video explains the three  reasons why I believe you should send me a refund regarding my recent purchase of the item:  Rocketek USB Numeric Keypad 18 keys mini USB 3.0 Hubs SD/TF Card Reader for Digital Keyboard Compute PC Laptop.  1) There are loose parts inside of the unit. 2) Memory card slot is too tight, posing a risk to the card itself and potentially the digital contents. 3) When inserting a USB cable to connect a Hard Drive, the Hard Drive does not show as a volume in the computer.  Thanks for your customer support.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is to document an allegedly defective USB keypad and support a buyer's refund request to the seller. The speaker describes a loose internal part, a memory-card slot requiring force, and an undetected hard drive as product-performance complaints in a purchase dispute. The sampled frame is consistent with a personal device demonstration setup, and no separate solicitation or deceptive mechanism is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary retail product purchase, a product-performance complaint and a refund request concerning the purchased device.
